connection_authentication.algorithm: No HMAC observed. Integrity is by AES-256-GCM tags (AEAD) in DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2; the public feed has no integrity protection at all (plain HTTP text from GitHub). No MAC authenticates a VPN connection.

limitations: The 'catalog' is a third-party public list that rotates and has no version: the first 40 lines are the catalog; the snapshot changes over time and the feed owner is not DGM.
libgojni.so is the stock Xray core: there is no encrypted catalog and no vendor key to recover.

Both real DGMTUNNEL_SHARE v2 links verified are expired (one also password-protected with an unknown password); the decrypted config of the unprotected one is NOT included in this dossier (it contains real credentials).
The CloudShares service (xhat-app.preview.emergentagent.com) is only a share-link service, not a catalog.
No .sks file format exists for DGM Tunnel.
